addendum6.notes: ROWSET ARM P: the sealed vocabulary tie-break RUN BACKWARDS, at fixed K=9,216 on wave 35's RETAINED MX35-CL896X13.  93,504,256 parameters, 0.4070832855x, ARCH.V9CL896X13's count TO THE BYTE, asserted by the builder before it wrote anything.  REGISTERED AT ONE AND READS ONE.  SIXTEEN WAVES HAVE MOVED HOW MANY VOCABULARY ROWS ARE KEPT AND THIS IS THE FIRST CHILD THAT MOVES WHICH.  The arm swapped 1,638 rows OUT and 1,638 rows IN -- symmetric difference 3,276 of 9,216 kept rows, jaccard 0.698176, normalised footrule 0.841210, all published in the receipt before the review -- which is MORE ROWS THAN THE ENTIRE 1,024-ROW BRACKET that separates the living V10CL896X09 from the dead V9CL896X09.  IT CHANGED FIFTEEN OF SIXTEEN LANES BY BYTES AND ZERO OF FIFTEEN CASES.  Only ONE lane of sixteen is byte-identical to the control's and its held lane is a DIFFERENT string from the control's, sha256 14e0fb46da3162cf against 111e342d9cb5438c, so this is a genuinely different decode landing on an identical count.  The mandatory set was held exactly as sealed and the identity gate -- this builder's ranker with the SEALED key reproducing mx41_vocab.choose_kept element for element -- passed on this build.

addendum9.clause: ADDENDUM 9 §9.1: the per-lane reading governs the frontier; both readings are computed, sealed and printed for every child
addendum9.derivation: the charged lanes are already counted as observed misses in the useful-or-partial total, so the per-lane reading re-scores nothing; it decides only whether the degeneracy clause fires, which it does when the degeneracy is general and does not when it is confined to identifiable lanes

axes.selection: the 9216 rows kept by the mandatory set (all added/special tokens, all 256 ByteLevel alphabet tokens and the transitive merge closure of both, taken from mx41_vocab.mandatory_ids), then the DISCRETIONARY fill in arm P's order until the budget is exactly met.  The census, the closure rule, the budget and the skip-if-it-does-not-fit branch are the sealed gather's; the ONLY variable is the order the discretionary candidates are considered in.  This arm moved 3276 rows of 9216 against the sealed control at the same K

The tokenizer is written by mx41_vocab.remapped_tokenizer, the same function that writes the deletion twin's, so a difference between the two children cannot be a difference between two tokenizer writers
